title: QuantumScape
summary: San Jose developer of solid-state lithium-metal batteries with a ceramic separator.
bodyHtml:
QuantumScape has developed a solid-state battery that replaces the liquid electrolyte and graphite anode with a ceramic separator and a lithium-metal anode.

The company licenses its technology to battery manufacturers rather than mass-producing cells itself, and has shipped sample cells to automotive partners for testing.

Why it matters

  • Ceramic separator
  • Lithium-metal anode
  • Licensing to cell makers

businessMeaning: Solid-state promises more range and faster charging, but manufacturability at scale has defeated many attempts. Licensing is a way to share that risk.
investmentLens: A listed pre-revenue technology company: the share price reflects milestone expectations, so timelines matter more than quarterly results.
